name: slides-presentation
summary: Animated slides: title/section/bullets/stat/quote/image/question slides with deck chrome ('n of N'), crossfades, VO-paced or auto-advance; --loop makes a seamless kiosk/booth loop

slots.title: deck title (header chrome)
slots.slides: list of {kind: title|section|bullets|stat|quote|image|question, title, subtitle?, bullets?, value?, label?, quote?, by?, image?, seconds?, vo?}

notes: Slide length = max(min_seconds, seconds, VO + pads), snapped to the bar. Kiosk: render with --loop (no fade-to-black; last frame == first).
